items.evidence: All three labware loaded with exact load names, slots and labels; p20 left and p300 right with correct tip racks in slots 10/11.
p20.transfer(2, plasmid_plate['A1'], tubes['A1']) uses the 20 µL pipette; default transfer has no mixing, so cells are handled gently.
Comment records 42C 45 s then ice 2 min in the right order, but it is a single comment with no operator pause/instruction.
p300.transfer(250, soc['A1'], tubes['A1']) after heat shock comment, followed by comment for 37C 60 min 250 rpm incubation.
new_tip='always' gives a fresh tip for DNA and SOC; checks tip_dropped_at_end and no_cross_contamination pass.
Volumes are within pipette limits, but there is no protocol.pause for the manual heat shock/ice/incubation steps and no explicit height or flow-rate choices.
Steps are exactly the four specified, in order, with accurate comments; no invented steps.

judge.summary: The protocol correctly implements all pipetting steps with the right pipettes, fresh tips and all measured checks passing. It loses some credit because the manual heat-shock and incubation steps are only comments with no operator pause, and it sets no cell-specific handling heights or flow rates.
